title: Letter grade
prompt: Turn a score into a letter: 90 or more is "A", 80 or more is "B", 70 or more is "C", anything lower is "F". letter_grade(85) is "B".
hints: elif lets you test several ranges in a row.
Start from the highest: `if score >= 90:`, then `elif score >= 80:`, `elif score >= 70:`, `else:`.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
